limitations: Public-dataset provisional evaluation only; not Tamil Nadu field accuracy.
Internal evidence review was not agricultural-expert verification.
Leaf Spot recall on the one-time untouched test was below the other classes.
Leaf Spot predictions have a strict frozen confidence threshold and may abstain frequently.
No treatment, prevention, pesticide, dosage, scheme, or price claim is authorized from the model output alone.
Any disease-management recommendation must be verify against official source.
allowed_app_behavior: Allow internal or controlled pilot inference only after the exact runtime bundle is installed and locally hash-verified.
Apply frozen temperature and class-specific confidence/margin gates exactly.
Abstain whenever the predicted class gate is not met.
Show that the result is provisional and not a confirmed diagnosis.
Require farmer crop confirmation before Redgram disease inference.
prohibited_app_behavior: Do not claim 93.02% Tamil Nadu accuracy.
Do not disable or weaken abstention.
Do not tune thresholds using the consumed test.
Do not reuse the 43-image test for model selection.
Do not automatically provide unverified treatment advice.
